title: What Is a Dolphin?
note: b415 — Phase 5 (School readiness) — new sounds 'wh' and 'ph'.

pages.brief: Nell the bee resting on a patch of warm golden sand.
Nell the bee looking out across a wide blue sea.
A wide view of the deep blue sea, waves rolling gently.
A grey dolphin swimming fast through the open sea.
A dolphin swimming near the surface, breathing at the top of the water.
A dolphin breaking the surface of the sea to breathe.
A dolphin leaping high out of the sea in a graceful arc.
A dolphin flipping in the air mid-leap above the waves.
A small group of dolphins swimming together through the sea.
Nell the bee watching happily as dolphins leap in the distance.
